suites.title: US-1.1: Enter Identity to Start the Assessment

specs.title: identity form has email, name, and team_type fields
team_type dropdown contains all four team options
Start Assessment button is disabled until all fields are filled
submitting identity form navigates to /assessment or shows resume banner
section count preview appears after selecting a team type

suites.title: US-1.2: Resume a Previous Session (returning respondent)

specs.title: app shows resume banner when valid session exists in localStorage
resume banner has a Continue Assessment button

suites.title: US-1.3: Session Persisted Across Browser Refresh

specs.title: af_token and af_session_id written to localStorage after identity submit
assessment page is accessible after page refresh using stored session

suites.title: US-0.1: Navigate the Assessment Section by Section

specs.title: Next button is visible on first section of assessment
Previous button is NOT shown on first section
section counter text shows current section out of total

suites.title: US-0.2: Track Progress Through the Assessment

specs.title: progress nav is visible with aria-label "Assessment progress"
progress nav items have ARIA labels describing current/completed/upcoming state
current section item has aria-current="step"

suites.title: US-0.3: Review All Answers Before Submitting

specs.title: /assessment/review page has "Review Your Answers" heading
/assessment/review has a Submit Assessment button
/assessment/review shows Edit buttons for each section

suites.title: US-0.4: Unanswered Required Questions Block Advancement

specs.title: clicking Next without answering required questions shows inline error
validation error message tells user to answer required questions
at least one radio button is rendered for single_choice questions
radio inputs are present when single_choice question is rendered
checkbox inputs are present when multi_choice question is rendered
textarea is present when free_text_long question is rendered
likert scale renders a radiogroup with 1-5 options when present
/assessment/confirmation page renders with confirmation content when seeded via sessionStorage
submit button appears on /assessment/review (not on section screens)
/dashboard/login renders the System Owner Login heading
/dashboard/login has an email input field
/dashboard/login has an Access Dashboard button
Access Dashboard button is disabled when email field is empty
login with non-system-owner email shows error message
/dashboard shows response table with Name, Email, Status columns
/dashboard redirects to /dashboard/login without a token
/dashboard/analytics redirects to /dashboard/login without a token
/dashboard/config page is reachable and shows Assessment Configuration heading
/dashboard/config shows Due Date field in config panel
GET /api/health returns HTTP 200
GET /api/health response body is valid JSON
